rationale: Identity: the held original (13 FR 1625, PDF p. 3) is Executive Order 9941 of March 26, 1948, a single delegation to the Secretary of State of the authority under sections 801(a) and 881(a) of the Foreign Service Act of 1946 to make rules for the Foreign Service Retirement and Disability System. In the held EO 10897 text (25 FR 12429), section 2 reads 'Executive Order No. 9941 of March 26, 1948, is hereby superseded', and section 3 makes the order effective as of October 16, 1960. EO 10897 itself re-delegates the same authority, so nothing independent of 9941 survives. Provisional no is supported.
